values.summary: Confirm #501 reviewed/published dependency, bind #502 as a stack on #501 while #501 is unmerged, implement pure lifecycle transition/capability rules, deterministic transaction storage/recovery replay, typed adapter fakes, crate-local AGENTS.md guidance, and focused transaction tests for retained requirements #168 through #170.

steps.action: Confirm #501 reviewed/published dependency and choose stacked base while #501 is not merged to main.
Implement pure lifecycle transition and capability-checking model.
Implement deterministic transaction storage, staged commit, and recovery replay model.
Implement typed Git/process adapter traits and fake adapters for boundary proof.
Add csdlc-v3/AGENTS.md guidance for the v3 crate, including the non-authoritative boundary and the three-minute issue-start simplification expectation.
Run transition-matrix, transaction-failure, recovery-replay, adapter-boundary, strict-clippy, diff-hygiene, and documentation-scope validation, then obtain independent review.

invariants: C-SDLC v2 remains sole operational authority.
Every lifecycle command/state pair has an explicit allowed or rejected outcome.
Modeled state commits are atomic and capability-checked.
Recovery preserves audit provenance and never silently rolls back committed authority.
Branch/worktree observation alone never authorizes lifecycle work.
The crate-local AGENTS.md must stay subordinate to root AGENTS.md and must not claim operational C-SDLC v3 authority.
risks: A partial modeled write is accidentally treated as authoritative.
Recovery replay drops provenance or creates an ambiguous state.
Adapter fakes mask shell-string or credential-scope hazards.
Crate-local agent guidance conflicts with root v2 authority or adds ceremony instead of simplifying issue starts.
The slice expands into V3-D workflow or v2 migration behavior.
stop_conditions: A lifecycle decision depends on branch-name observation alone.
A Git/process adapter accepts shell strings or ambient credentials.
The slice performs live GitHub or lifecycle mutation.
csdlc-v3/AGENTS.md conflicts with root AGENTS.md or blocks a prepared issue from being inspected, bound, and started quickly.
Work expands into V3-D or v2 migration.
